title: Onye A Kpọrọ Aha Ya n'Ezinụlọ Onye Amụma
intro: N'ezinụlọ onye ozi ikpeazụ ahụ, e nwere otu mkpụrụ obi nke akụkọ ya ghọrọ ihe mmụta Chineke nye ndị kwere ekwe niile. Ndụ onye a nwere njikọ chiri anya na iwu mgbanwe nke gbanwere omenala mmekọrịta mmadụ na ibe ya ruo mgbe ebighị ebi, na-egosi nnukwu mgbanwe n'otú okwukwe ga-esi kọwaa ezinụlọ na ihe nketa.
clues: Aha m nwere njikọ na otu ezinụlọ dị nsọ, mana eziokwu dị elu ga-eme ka njikọ nke okwukwe doo anya ma emechaa.
Abụ m onye natara nnukwu amara site n'aka Allah na onye ozi Ya, amara nke e kwupụtara n'ihu ọha n'akwụkwọ ahụ.
Ndụ alụmdi na nwunye m ghọrọ ule dị mkpa nke ga-agbanwe echiche nke mmekọrịta e kenyere ruo mgbe ebighị ebi.
Abụ m onye ikpe nke onwe ya dugara n'iwu Chineke nke mere ka Onye Amụma ahụ lụọ nwanyị mgbe m hapụrụ.
Site n'akụkọ m, e mere ka ọdịiche dị n'etiti ezinụlọ sitere n'ọmụmụ na ezinụlọ ahọpụtara doo anya ruo ọgbọ niile.
Naanị m bụ onye otu m, aha ya pụtara ìhè nke ọma n'ime mkpughe ikpeazụ, ọ bụghị dị ka onye amụma, kama dị ka onye ohu a nwalere ma sọpụrụ.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
